mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Greek word meaning a permanent tonic prominence given to the last syllable on a speech chain."
Oxytony is a Greek word meaning a permanent tonic prominence given to the last syllable on a speech chain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to concepts like regularity, periodicity, spacing, and patterning, to mention but a few."
Succession refers to concepts like regularity, periodicity, spacing, and patterning, to mention but a few.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an all-embracing activity that goes beyond silent reading."
Mastery of oral reading is an all-embracing activity that goes beyond silent reading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital aspect of language development strategy that fosters the mastery of oral language, but silent reading is not. 4."
Reading aloud is a vital aspect of language development strategy that fosters the mastery of oral language, but silent reading is not. 4.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to an action that is natural, instinctive, something that is happening at the spur of the moment. 2."
Spontaneous refers to an action that is natural, instinctive, something that is happening at the spur of the moment. 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in segmenting/demarcating linguistic boundaries in the speech chain."
Stress groups are used in segmenting/demarcating linguistic boundaries in the speech chain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the learner's inability to manage pauses."
The difficulty is the learner's inability to manage pauses.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first original form of any living language and for a learner to claim to have mastery in a foreign language that mastery must begin with the oral level."
The oral code is the first original form of any living language and for a learner to claim to have mastery in a foreign language that mastery must begin with the oral level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an opportunity for you to put to use all you must have learnt in earlier units of your course on articulatory phonetics."
Speaking on telephone is an opportunity for you to put to use all you must have learnt in earlier units of your course on articulatory phonetics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a suprasegmental element of speech structure."
Intonation is a suprasegmental element of speech structure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series of syllables (one or several words) which are run together and the last of which receives a slight stress."
A stress group is a series of syllables (one or several words) which are run together and the last of which receives a slight stress.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means smooth-flowing, connected speech, appropriate timing and distribution of prosodic infrastructure. 3."
Rather it simply means smooth-flowing, connected speech, appropriate timing and distribution of prosodic infrastructure. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the situational variant in which we expect the incidence of syntactic pauses. 2."
Reading is the situational variant in which we expect the incidence of syntactic pauses. 2.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most appropriate yardstick for measuring learner's spontaneous speech production since it represents an ideal competence level which all must aspire to acquire."
Native speaker competence is the most appropriate yardstick for measuring learner's spontaneous speech production since it represents an ideal competence level which all must aspire to acquire.

Only reading
Only reading is the situational variant that can lend itself to proper objective measurement of fluency.

breath group
A breath group is any sequence of speech that can be pronounced on one breath.

English
English is a stress-timed language, whereas French is a syllable-timed language.

occurrence of reparanda

oral reading exercise

speech chain
